encounters.title: Roadside Memorial
encounters.description: Melted candle stubs sit inside cut tin cans around a bent road marker. A photograph has been removed, but one corner remains beneath a stone. The wax has pooled and frozen in grey discs.

choices.text: Leave it untouched.
Take the candle stubs and any small offering left behind.

encounters.title: Crashed Supply Truck
encounters.description: A logistics vehicle has crushed its cab into the ditch. Torn inventory tags cling to the rear doors. Several crates were removed long before you arrived, but one has split open on the road.

choices.text: Search the split crate and cab for salvage.
Investigate the cab for documents or personal effects.
Move on. Someone already took what was worth taking.

encounters.title: Frozen Evacuation Bus
encounters.description: The doors are frozen open. Frost films the inside of the windows. A child's shoe lies upright on one seat beneath a luggage rack. The heating vents are clogged with ash.

choices.text: Search the luggage rack for supplies.
Leave the bus undisturbed.
Check the transit tag on the dashboard for a destination.

encounters.title: Improvised Grave
encounters.description: A shallow mound has been reinforced with stones. A name is scratched into a broken plank with a date and nothing else. The earth is frozen hard.

choices.text: Pay respects and move on.
Read the name and date scratched into the plank.
Check beneath the stones for any buried belongings.

encounters.title: Collapsed Bridge
encounters.description: One span lies in the river at an angle. A vehicle is wedged against the concrete below, only its rear half above the waterline. The current has carved a channel through the debris.

choices.text: Climb down to the wedged vehicle and search the cargo area.
Examine the collapsed span for salvageable steel or cable.
Find a way around. The structure looks unstable.

encounters.title: Drainage Pipe
encounters.description: Blankets have been pushed deep into a concrete culvert. A warning is scratched into the wall where rainwater cannot wash it away. Something has been living here recently.

choices.text: Crawl inside and check the blankets for supplies.
Read the warning scratched into the concrete.
Leave it alone. Someone may come back.

encounters.title: Rail Siding
encounters.description: A wheelset has sunk into the ballast. The maintenance ledger is still clipped beside the door of a derailed freight car. The last pages were written in different handwriting.

choices.text: Search the freight car for industrial salvage.
Read the maintenance ledger.
The car has been picked over. Move on.

encounters.title: Dead Livestock Area
encounters.description: Ear tags glitter among the weeds. The bodies were moved into a rough line before whoever did the work stopped. The smell is long gone, but the contamination lingers.

choices.text: Scavenge usable material from the remains.
Inspect the ear tags for farm identification.
Keep your distance. The contamination risk is not worth it.

encounters.title: Ruined Greenhouse
encounters.description: Most of the panes are gone. Dry seed trays remain labeled beneath the benches. One cabinet is still sealed against moisture. The door has been forced once but not fully opened.

choices.text: Take the labeled seed trays.
Force the sealed cabinet open.
Leave the greenhouse for whoever finds it next.

encounters.title: Shell Crater
encounters.description: The earth is glassy along one side of the crater. A torn harness and fragments of stamped metal are half-buried in the frozen soil. The ground sounds hollow when you step near the edge.

choices.text: Carefully inspect the crater edge for salvage.
Dig out the harness and stamped metal fragments.
The ground is unstable. Walk around.

encounters.title: Abandoned Field Kitchen
encounters.description: A large cooking pot is frozen to the stand. Ladles hang from wire hooks. Ration marks have been scratched into the serving table. The fire pit is cold and clean-swept.

choices.text: Search the kitchen area for preserved food or fuel.
Take the ladles and cooking implements.
Read the ration marks scratched into the table.

encounters.title: Abandoned Generator
encounters.description: The casing is open and two cables have been cut cleanly. Someone marked the fuel mixture on the frame in grease pencil. The engine block is cold but intact.

choices.text: Strip the generator for electrical components.
Copy the fuel mixture notes from the frame.
Mark the location for a future salvage team.

encounters.title: Roadside Shrine
encounters.description: Candles have burned down inside a rusted food tin. Small offerings sit beneath a strip of cloth tied to the guardrail. The cloth is faded but carefully knotted.

choices.text: Leave the shrine undisturbed.
Take the small offerings left beneath the cloth.
Leave a small offering of your own.

encounters.title: Emergency Cache
encounters.description: The weather seal has cracked but the stencil is still readable. Someone tried the lock with a pry bar and gave up. The stencil reads CIVIL DEFENSE — EMERGENCY RATION CACHE.

choices.text: Force the cracked seal and open the cache.
Leave the cache sealed. Someone may need it more.

encounters.title: Military Observation Post
encounters.description: The optics mount still points toward the crossing. Grid references are written on the inside wall beside dates that stop abruptly. A spent cartridge sits on the windowsill.

choices.text: Search the post for optics or intelligence documents.
Copy the grid references and dates from the wall.
The post has been stripped. Move on.

encounters.title: Abandoned Barricade
encounters.description: Traffic arrows were repainted twice in different colors. A body lies behind the barrier beside a box that was opened from the road-facing side. The sandbags have frozen solid.

choices.text: Search the barricade for supplies left behind.
Examine the faction markings on the barricade.
Circle around. The body suggests this was not a safe place.

encounters.title: Hunting Blind
encounters.description: The blind has collapsed on one side. A thermos, empty cartridge box, and a journal wrapped in cloth remain under the bench. The journal is damp but legible.

choices.text: Search the blind for hunting supplies.
Read the damp journal.
Leave the blind as you found it.

encounters.title: Damaged Radio Tower
encounters.description: The mast has folded halfway down the hill. One feed line is intact and disappears into a locked cabinet at the base. The cabinet has been pried but not opened.

choices.text: Force the cabinet open and salvage the components.
Check the cabinet for a frequency log or maintenance record.
The tower is beyond repair. Move on.

encounters.title: Destroyed Checkpoint
encounters.description: Concrete barriers are blackened on the shelter-facing side. A logbook is pinned beneath a fallen chair where rain has not reached it. The checkpoint identity plate is missing.

choices.text: Search the checkpoint for confiscated goods or supplies.
Read the logbook beneath the chair.
The destruction suggests heavy fighting. Keep moving.

encounters.title: Abandoned Tent
encounters.description: The tent fabric has collapsed under snow. Inside, cups are nested together beside a folded child's drawing kept dry inside a plastic sleeve. The zipper is frozen shut.

choices.text: Cut open the tent and search for supplies.
Take the child's drawing from the plastic sleeve.
Leave the tent undisturbed.

encounters.title: Makeshift Clinic
encounters.description: Triage numbers are written on strips of cardboard. Empty saline bags hang from a cable. The medicine cabinet has been searched unevenly — some shelves are bare, others untouched.

choices.text: Search the untouched shelves for medical supplies.
Read the triage numbers on the cardboard strips.
Leave the clinic intact. Others may need it.

encounters.title: Crashed Drone
encounters.description: One wing is embedded in hard soil. The casing has been opened once, but the flight-control compartment is still sealed. Battery acid has stained the ground beneath it.

choices.text: Force open the flight-control compartment.
Attempt to extract the flight log from the sealed compartment.
The battery acid suggests chemical risk. Leave it.

encounters.title: Fuel Cache
encounters.description: Two containers are buried beneath a sheet of corrugated metal. A route sketch has been scratched into one lid with a nail. The containers are heavy and sealed.

choices.text: Dig up the containers and take the fuel.
Copy the route sketch from the lid.
Leave the cache hidden. You may need it later.

encounters.title: Water Source
encounters.description: A metal cup is tied to a hand pump with wire. Mineral staining marks the basin. Someone has written a date beside the word for 'safe' in charcoal. The pump handle moves freely.

choices.text: Pump and collect water from the source.
Test the water quality before collecting.
The mineral staining is suspicious. Move on.

encounters.title: Supply Drop
encounters.description: The parachute is tangled in dead trees. The crate markings identify a destination several kilometres from where it actually landed. The crate is intact but the seal is broken.

choices.text: Open the crate and take what is inside.
Read the shipping label for destination and origin information.
Leave the crate. It was meant for someone else.
